media.name: Concord Wire
media.description: Dry interstellar business, port and regulatory reporting syndicated across known space.
media.audience: Carriers, brokers, manufacturers and anyone whose money depends on a rule changing.

media.name: Freightline
media.description: Ship reviews, maintenance advisories, used-hull prices and long-form reporting on freight economics.

media.name: Meridian Traffic
media.description: Dock assignments, arrivals, delays, classifieds and local reporting mixed into one indispensable feed.

media.name: Outer Band
media.description: Recorded interviews, music, repair talk and messages exchanged among outer settlements when bandwidth permits.

media.name: Return Board
media.description: Lists filed expedition return windows and whether vessels have checked back in.
media.audience: Survey crews, families, insurers and curious locals.

food_lodging.name: Common Galley
food_lodging.description: Generic term for inexpensive multispecies cafeterias near freight docks. Menus identify nutrition, allergens and environmental serving conditions more prominently than cuisine.

food_lodging.name: Berthhouse
food_lodging.description: Cheap short-stay lodging for crews whose ships are inaccessible during loading, inspection or repair. Rooms are sold by gravity/humidity configuration.

food_lodging.name: Chandler Packs
food_lodging.description: Provision bundles sold by crew composition and voyage duration rather than individual meals.

food_lodging.name: Night Kitchens
food_lodging.description: Container City food stalls serving construction and mine shifts around the clock; menus change whenever a different inbound food shipment is cheap.

food_lodging.name: Reheat
food_lodging.description: Carver slang for inexpensive prepared food made from surplus station provisioning. Quality ranges from excellent to technically edible.

education.name: Concord Commercial Operator Certificate
education.description: Widely recognized baseline qualification covering navigation law, cargo documentation, emergency procedure and mixed-species passenger obligations.

education.name: Roosevelt Yard Schools
education.description: Dozens of competing technical schools feed New Houston shipyards. Practical certifications often matter more locally than prestigious academic degrees.

education.name: Kesh Heavy Apprenticeship
education.description: Long-form supervised industrial training emphasizing inspection, responsibility and maintenance history.

education.name: Lastlight Outbound Orientation
education.description: Short practical course covering unsupported navigation, reserve planning, contamination protocol and filing a useful survey report.
